algorithm.authority: The named reference entry point and source SHA-256 define all accepted input, rejection, alpha-normalization, namespace-prefix, and canonical-byte behavior not redundantly demonstrated by the vectors. Independent implementations must be observationally identical and may not import the agent at runtime.
algorithm.input_profile: An XML document accepted by the named reference entry point as a closed retrieval OpenMath proposition.
steps: parse and validate the document with the reference OpenMath XML validator and retrieval profile with require_closed=true
deep-copy the parsed root, then alpha-normalize declarations using the reference tree traversal, lexical shadowing, and declaration order
remove only ignorable whitespace using the reference traversal

serialize with the CPython 3.12 ElementTree canonicalize call arguments with_comments=false, strip_text=false, rewrite_prefixes=true, qname_aware_tags=set(), qname_aware_attrs=set(), exclude_tags=set(), and exclude_attrs=set()
require exactly one serialization transport artifact ` xmlns:n0=""`, remove that exact substring once, and reject if the remaining UTF-8 bytes do not parse as XML
algorithm.payload_preimage: RFC 8785 UTF-8 serialization of {id, canonical_statement, openmath_xml, proof_strategy, sketch_steps}, where openmath_xml is the canonical XML in the matching vector
